newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat, c.bank seen curbing rise.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat, c.bank seen curbing rise.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,502-1,506 per dollar, virtually unchanged from the morning's 1,498-1,506, as the central bank was seen curbing a possible lev rise amid increased dollar supply, dealers said.
"The market was dormant. The lev idled near opening levels and the central bank was the main foreign currency buyer as demand from banks and clients was low," a commercial bank dealer said.
The lev could have easily firmed if the central bank had not bought dollars because foreign currency supply from clients was high, traders said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.

Dollar supply was expected to top demand from commercial banks and clients in the next days and movements in exchange rate would strongly depend on the central bank's behaviour. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
